title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta1

## Vendor trail / MQTT tail field-test view

This prerelease adds a temporary visual source-debug mode for the new retained vendor trail pipeline in Navimower 0.4.5-beta3.

### Source-separated live trail

- Keep the normal configured trail color for the integration-owned current-cycle render, which now includes the vendor-retained mowing trail supplied by Navimower 0.4.5-beta3.
- Render the still-unconfirmed MQTT-only live tail in fixed red (`#ff0000`) while the beta debug metadata is present.
- As each refreshed vendor trail catches up, the integration removes the already-covered MQTT prefix; the red trail therefore shrinks from its older end instead of remaining underneath the vendor trail.
- When the browser has received newer live positions after the last Map API refresh, append only positions after the backend tail's retained anchor. This prevents the old browser-local MQTT session from reappearing after the backend has already trimmed it.
- Use a small spatial match tolerance for the browser/backend anchor because vendor and MQTT samples do not necessarily land on identical XY coordinates.
- Apply the same red live-tail styling to Single mower and Multi mower views.

### Debug intent

This color split is intentionally temporary and is meant to answer field-test questions such as how frequently the vendor retained path advances, how long the MQTT tail normally remains visible, and what happens around zone transitions, pause/resume, charging and completion.

### Compatibility

- Pair with **Navimower 0.4.5-beta3** for the vendor-backbone/MQTT-tail payload contract.
- With older integrations the normal live-trail behavior is retained; the special backend-authoritative tail logic activates only when the new debug metadata is present.
- Existing card configuration, History, underlays, Gate areas, scheduler and Multi mower behavior remain unchanged.
